data.name: VR Blacksmithing
data.detailed_description:
Step into the forge and shape hot steel with your own hands in VR Blacksmithing, a hands-on VR forging game focused on heat, hammer control, and the satisfying process of shaping metal into real objects.

This is not a crafting game where you press a button and a finished item appears. In VR Blacksmithing, the goal is to capture the feel and logic of real forging in a way that is physical, and rewarding. Heat steel in the forge, bring it to the anvil, and use blacksmithing techniques like tapering, twisting, and bending to transform raw stock into a masterpiece.

Built for virtual reality from the ground up, the experience is centered on interacting directly with your tools and material. Watch steel heat up, move it between stations, and shape it through repeated strikes and careful handling. Every project is about working the metal and applying the skills you've mastered.

Whether you are curious about learning to blacksmith, love hands-on simulation games, or just want to spend time in a warm and immersive environment, VR Blacksmithing is designed to make forging feel tactile, grounded, and satisfying.

Features

  • Heat and work steel in a VR smithing environment

  • Shape metal by hammering, tapering, twisting, and cutting

  • Use real blacksmithing logic as the foundation for gameplay

  • Create forged items through a hands-on process

  • Experience a cozy, immersive workshop atmosphere

  • Designed to be approachable for new players

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • VR Support: OpenXR / SteamVR. VR headset and tracked motion controllers required. Standing play supported. Tested with Meta Quest 2 and Quest 3.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • VR Support: OpenXR / SteamVR. VR headset and tracked motion controllers required. Standing play supported. Tested with Meta Quest 2 and Quest 3.
